title: Remove the five redundant post-restart default capture installs in the EO reporting tests
outcome: Remove the five redundant post-restart default capture installs in the EO reporting tests
acceptance: The five `install_reporting_source_capture(&restarted);` calls made redundant by restart_reporting_state's pre-listen install are removed: engram_unadmitted_runtime_reporting.rs in restart_before_reply_replays_the_same_report_from_real_session_storage, an_identity_collision_is_terminal_disclosed_and_not_sent_again and a_collision_whose_settlement_is_not_stored_is_never_resent_live_and_replays_identically_after_restart; engram_unadmitted_reporting_repairs.rs in restored_closing_delete_retry_preserves_the_paused_successor_without_provider_replay and restored_closing_capture_uses_its_pinned_work_without_a_control_rebind
The custom slow capture hook in restored_closing_capture_survives_a_source_measurement_longer_than_the_rpc_cap stays installed between read.wait() and read.release()
The affected tests pass unchanged otherwise
